item.tib: sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las stag gzig mkha' 'gro bdun gyi mjal skor
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ yi ger btab pa bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal gyis/ nam mkhas khyab tshad sems can rnams/ bon nyid dbyings su ye sangs rgyas par shog bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ nam mkha' ci bzhin bkra shis shog/
